title: Animals that migrate
examples: Why do some animals move so far away?
What makes animals change where they live?
Do all animals migrate when the weather changes?

explain.say: Some animals make a long trip every year.
Birds fly to warmer places when it gets cold.

draw.text: Birds move when it gets cold

explain.say: Whales swim to different oceans as the water changes.
Butterflies can travel very far looking for flowers.
These long trips happen because of the changing seasons.
Think about a family moving to a new house for the winter.

faq.a: Birds fly south to find warmer weather and more food.
asks: Where do birds go when it is cold?

faq.q: Do all animals that move long distances?
faq.a: No, only some animals migrate when the seasons change.
asks: Are there animals that never move?

faq.a: The changing seasons affect the food and weather for the animals.
asks: Why do animals need to move?

faq.a: Yes, some butterflies can travel many miles looking for food.
asks: How far can a butterfly fly?

faq.a: Yes, whales swim to different areas of the ocean as their food moves.
asks: Do whales change their swimming spots?
Where do whales go in the ocean?

facts: Migration is a regular, long journey for animals.
Animals move to find food or warmer temperatures.
Seasons like winter and summer cause these movements.
Different animals, like birds and whales, migrate differently.

quiz.say: Birds move south when the weather becomes:
quiz.why: Birds need warmth to survive when it gets cold.

wrong.0: Rainy weather is not the main reason for their big trip.
wrong.2: Hot weather usually means they stay put.
wrong.3: Sunny weather is good, but it does not force them to move.

quiz.say: Whales change their location mainly because of:
quiz.why: Whales follow where their food, like fish, is found.

wrong.0: Wind can push them, but it is not the main reason for their journey.
wrong.1: While temperature matters, food is the main guide for whales.
wrong.3: Tides move water, but they do not move the food source.

quiz.say: If an animal moves from a place to another place over a year, it is called:
quiz.why: Migration is the correct word for a yearly, long animal journey.

wrong.0: Traveling is a general word; migration is specific to animals.
wrong.1: Seasoning means adding flavor, not moving places.
wrong.2: Wandering means moving without a clear goal, which is not always true.
